svg.title: Riju submits four urgent corrections from the crowded server cupboard.
svg.desc: Riju works his refurbished terminal beside an open satchel while four separate blank panes represent the flood warning, lane closure, clinical override and welfare appeal. Cecil monitors the submissions.
svg.text: Page 42, panel 1 · Over-Riju view into the cramped server cupboard

text.tspan: Riju submits four emergency corrections in quick
succession without hiding their different sources.
